name: archray
description: AI-first architecture visualiser: a Skill + CLI that turns a repository into layered, interactive, offline HTML views.

scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=core run typecheck && npm --workspace=viewer run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.cli.json
scripts.build: npm run gen:schema && npm run gen:brands && npm run gen:knowledge && npm run build:viewer && npm run build:cli
scripts.build:site: npm run build && node cli/bin/archray.mjs build examples/freshmart.graph.json --output site/demo.html --force --no-open
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build:site && npx --yes wrangler deploy
